apis.name: ALL Large Deals (Bulk, Block & Short Selling)

publishTimes.description: Block deals executed in the morning pre-market window (8:45 AM - 9:00 AM) are published here before cash open.
Block deals executed in the afternoon window (2:05 PM - 2:20 PM) are published during the live market.
Full consolidated list of open-market trades >= 0.5% equity float and institutional short sale disclosures.

apis.description: Single consolidated endpoint containing all Bulk Deals, Block Deals, and Short Selling transactions. Separate sub-views are provided below to inspect each dataset independently.

subTabs.label: Bulk Deals
subTabs.description: Open-market trades crossing 0.5% of total listed equity capital (Published after market hours).

subTabs.label: Block Deals
subTabs.description: Large institutional transactions executed in 15-min designated windows (Published 9:12-9:15 AM and after 2:20 PM).

subTabs.label: Short Selling
subTabs.description: Institutional short positions backed by securities lending and borrowing (Published after market hours).
